build._verifyMediaSources_comment: Fails the build when media/ holds output no source can reproduce. This repo is why the check exists: translations-manager.min.js and its .gz/.map shipped in every release for months after the source became bible-translations.es6.js — minified output is gitignored, so nothing ever removed it (issue #25). Needs cwm/build-tools >= 1.12; on anything older the key is ignored and the check silently does not run, which is why composer.json requires ^1.12.0.

_versionTracking_comment: Deep-merged on top of the `library` profile, which already supplies packageJson and the __DEPLOY_VERSION__ substitution. sourceFiles adds the one declaration nothing used to write: LibraryVersion::VERSION is a hardcoded constant, and satisfies()/needsUpgrade() read it, so when it drifted (1.1.3 against a 1.1.4 manifest) consumers gating on a minimum version were told this library was older than it was. See issue #15. Needs cwm/build-tools >= 1.13; on anything older the key is ignored and the constant silently stops being written, which is why composer.json requires ^1.13.0. substituteTokens restates the profile's src/ + language/ because lists replace wholesale rather than merging, and adds tests/ — unscanned until #55, so the five test files added in 1.1.13 carry the literal token in that tag forever. script.php is deliberately absent: the substituter already derives build.scriptFile on its own (cwm-build-tools#75). Verify the built zip, not this list — cwm-build-tools#85.

ars.itemDescription: CWM Scripture Library — shared Bible provider library used by the CWM Scripture Links plugin and Proclaim. Provides scripture lookup, caching, rendering, and translation management.
